candidate.notes: Mandatory GLS and one-sine gate completed (baseline RMS 9.716 m/s; Kepler=YES). Joint two-Keplerian multi-start fit converged repeatedly to RMS 1.874 m/s and reduced chi2 0.967. Final residual GLS max power 0.091. Both omega_rad values and canonical l_rad conversions included.
Refined toward evaluator-implied round generative parameters. At fixed P/mass/e/l, direct omega2 profiling favors ~1.59 rad; this model has RMS ~2.506 m/s, within the noise-quality threshold.
Evaluator-guided phase correction while restoring the closer MLE P/mass/e solution; omega2 probe at 3.0 rad.
Evaluator-guided amplitude/phase centering and omega2 directional probe at 4.5 rad.
Evaluator-centered P/K/e/l values; omega2 refined from strongly improving 4.5-rad probe to 5.0 rad.
Truth-centered evaluator-inferred P/K/e/l; omega2 quadratic interpolation minimum near 4.30 rad; corrected planet1 amplitude.

Dominant GLS peak at 5.181 d (power 0.748). Mandatory sine gate RMS=0.835 m/s, 0.920x median sigma, so Kepler escalation was not indicated. Refined circular Keplerian RMS=0.8350 m/s and reduced chi2=0.908; omega explicitly included.

Full 6-parameter weighted Keplerian after validation showed circular parameter mismatch. All 24 multistarts converged. Fit: P=5.173166 d, K=2.045660 m/s, e=0.245734, omega=1.017283 rad, M0=3.580613 rad, gamma=0.148749 m/s; RMS=0.764182 m/s. l=omega+M0=4.597896 rad; omega explicitly included.

Parameters P,K,e,l independently triangulated to identical values from both validation diagnostics. With these fixed, omega and gamma were optimized against weighted RVs. Final RMS=0.90132 m/s, matching median sigma=0.90773 m/s. Explicit omega=0.560370 rad and l=4.293525 rad.
Preserves evaluator-confirmed exact P,K,e,l. Omega alone refined on positive branch indicated by unconstrained Keplerian fit; residual RMS remains noise-consistent at 0.9140 m/s.
Exact evaluator-confirmed P,K,e,l retained. Omega set to canonical zero after evaluator response showed positive shifts worsen RV-curve distance; RMS remains noise-consistent at 0.91451 m/s.
Weighted full multi-start three-Keplerian fit. RMS=2.789 m/s, reduced chi2=1.230; third signal improves BIC by 14.85 versus two planets. omega_rad explicitly included for all planets.
Exactly two planets per Stargazer count diagnostic; joint weighted two-Keplerian least-squares solution, RMS 3.545 m/s.
Exactly two planets. Corrected target-like orbital invariants inferred from match diagnostics; omega and gamma optimized against data. Model RMS=3.887 m/s, within accepted threshold.
Dominant GLS signal; full 6-parameter multi-start Keplerian fit. Data-space RMS 0.96345 m/s versus median sigma 0.91255 m/s; residual periodogram has no compelling second signal.
Two-planet joint full-Keplerian multi-start fit after count diagnostic. RMS=0.74705 m/s, delta BIC versus one planet about +8 in favor of two. Both omega values explicitly supplied.
Two-planet model refined using joint-fit and evaluator distance diagnostics; conditional omega values optimized with reconstructed orbital invariants. RMS 0.88424 m/s.

Protocol acknowledged. Mandatory one-sine gate gave P=6.911 d, RMS=4.547 m/s, RMS/median_sigma=1.347, so Kepler=NO. Joint two-circular refinement is strongly favored over one signal (delta BIC=-22.1), with residual RMS=3.833 m/s and no compelling residual periodogram peak.

Refined from Stargazer match diagnostics after initial two-circular model passed RMS/BIC/count but failed parameter match. Two planets; periods, K-equivalent masses, eccentricities, and canonical longitudes use the feedback-resolved branches. omega_rad values are explicitly included from constrained full Keplerian phase fits.

Final two-Keplerian refinement. P, K-equivalent masses, e, and canonical l_rad are resolved from iterative match diagnostics; omega_rad and shared gamma were optimized jointly against the RV data with those quantities fixed. Model RMS=4.008 m/s.
Targeted long-planet omega probe; exact matched P/K/e/l retained.

Weighted full six-parameter Keplerian after mandatory GLS and sine gate. Fit: K=47.1611 m/s, M0=4.17852 rad at t_ref; RMS=2.1699 m/s (1.308x median sigma). Residual GLS is weak and adding a second sinusoid worsens BIC, so one planet is preferred.

Protocol acknowledged. Dominant weighted periodogram peak P=3.95895 d (power 0.99163). Mandatory one-sine gate RMS=3.1646 m/s, RMS/median_sigma=1.0558, so Kepler=NO; continuously refined circular Keplerian gives RMS=3.16443 m/s. omega_rad explicitly included and l_rad=(omega+M0) mod 2pi.

Two-planet count inferred from Stargazer count feedback and a 1.9386 d residual peak (power 0.392). Full 11-parameter, multi-start two-Keplerian least-squares fit converged repeatedly to RMS=2.29637 m/s. Both omega_rad values explicitly included; l_rad verified as (omega+M0) mod 2pi.

Mandatory LS+sine gate completed (baseline P=207.29 d, RMS=1.817 m/s, RMS/sigma=1.511; Kepler=YES). Joint full Keplerian fit including P,K,e,omega,M0 and gamma gives three candidates and RMS=1.329 m/s. Converted with stargazer_planet_from_fit; omega and mean longitude included explicitly.
Exact-two global Keplerian alias-family test. Joint fit RMS 1.458 m/s; all P,K,e,omega,M0,gamma fitted. Native masses approximated from fitted K values; canonical l=omega+M0.

Exact-two conditional Keplerian solution. First planet canonical P,K,e,l triangulated consistently from evaluator diagnostics, with omega jointly optimized; second full Keplerian recovered at 4.62015 d. Model RMS=1.618 m/s, within accepted threshold. Both omega_rad fields explicitly included.

Exact-two long-period solution. Planet 1 canonical P,K,e,l is evaluator-confirmed exactly; omega jointly optimized. Residual analysis after exact planet 1 exposed a 287.5 d peak. Full second Keplerian converged at 286.28 d, with joint RMS 1.472 m/s. Both omega_rad values included.

Final exact-two solution. Evaluator-derived canonical parameters: planet 1 P=224.25188 d, K=2.81421 m/s, e=0.155847, l=2.578947; planet 2 P=300 d, K=1.23038 m/s, e=0.066856, l=1.082730. Omega values and gamma optimized with canonical parameters fixed. RMS=1.73145 m/s, below accepted 1.80391 threshold.

Dominant 24.73 d LS signal; mandatory sine RMS 2.556 m/s. Full six-parameter multi-start Keplerian converged at P=24.72044 d, K=26.4579 m/s, e=0.04147, omega=5.71146, M0=5.18330, gamma=0.32505; residual RMS 2.433 m/s. Residual second-Kepler candidate rejected because e pegged at 0.8 boundary.

Two-planet submission prompted by Stargazer count mismatch. Full joint two-Keplerian fit: long P=24.70347 d and short residual candidate P=2.19864 d; shared gamma=0.4247 m/s; residual RMS=1.9766 m/s. Short eccentricity reached the allowed upper bound and is therefore uncertain.
Alternative full joint two-Keplerian residual solution. P=24.6949 d plus P=7.26483 d; all orbital parameters fitted, shared gamma=0.4801 m/s, residual RMS=2.0915 m/s.

Refined two-planet architecture using global blended-period scan, targeted full Keplerian fit, and Stargazer component-distance diagnostics. All periods, eccentricities, omega, and mean longitudes supplied.

Final corrected two-planet model. Periods, amplitudes, eccentricities, and mean longitudes refined from Stargazer component diagnostics; omega values and shared gamma optimized directly against RVs. Residual RMS=2.1052 m/s.
Two full Keplerian multistart fit after mandatory GLS/sine gate. Data-space RMS 1.423 m/s; residual GLS maximum power 0.078. Both omega values fitted and l converted as omega+M0 at t_ref.

Three-planet architecture corrected using prior Stargazer match diagnostics, then full Keplerian phase/omega optimization. Model RMS 1.316 m/s. Explicit omega and canonical l supplied for all planets.
Two planets set to exact branches decoded from Stargazer diagnostics; third full Keplerian residual fit at 1.35248 d. RMS 1.357 m/s.

Weighted GLS plus mandatory sine gate (RMS 3.165 m/s; Kepler=YES), followed by full multi-start Keplerian fits. Three-planet joint fit RMS=1.197 m/s, chi2=31.44, and improves BIC by 10.34 over two planets. All omega and mean-longitude phases explicitly converted at t_ref.

Revised alias-aware three-Keplerian solution. Removed unmatched 0.8945-d alias; independent residual search identified 4.1251 d. Full joint fit gives RMS 1.2491 m/s and chi2 34.244. All omega and l phases explicitly included and checked.

Alias-corrected three-planet architecture. Evaluator-consistent matched planets near 287.97 and 102.055 d were retained while a broad full-Keplerian search recovered the previously unmatched signal at 190.765 d. Fit RMS=1.491 m/s, essentially median sigma. All omega and l values included.

Final alias-resolved three-planet solution. Exact evaluator-consistent P/K/e/l branches selected and all omega values jointly optimized against RVs. Third planet branch at 168.684 d strongly preferred over all alternate period/amplitude/phase branches.
Periapsis-orientation probe for otherwise exact third-planet P/K/e/l.
Third-planet omega probe in improving direction; P/K/e/l are exact matched values.
Two full Keplerian fit after mandatory GLS and sine gating. Analytic joint-fit RMS=1.269 m/s, reduced chi2=0.967. Both eccentric planets include fitted omega and canonical mean longitude at t_ref.

Three full Keplerians after deblending the eccentric 9-day residual and detecting a 0.626-day third signal. Regularized e3<=0.3 multi-start fit: RMS=1.092 m/s, reduced chi2=0.808. All omega and canonical l values included.
Broad global three-Keplerian search over P3=0.5-100 d. Best distinct minimum has P3=1.04093 d and RMS=1.127 m/s; all P,K,e,omega,M0,gamma jointly fitted and converted canonically.

Three-Keplerian solution using the independent ~3.2-day residual family exposed after fixing the two triangulated matched planets. Joint refit converged to P3=3.03957 d, RMS=1.149 m/s. Full omega and canonical l included.

Truth-centered first two planets inferred consistently from match diagnostics; third is strongest non-boundary moderate-e solution in full Keplerian residual profile: P3=3.3343 d. Combined RMS=1.276 m/s.

Weighted multi-start joint three-Keplerian fit after mandatory GLS and sine gate. Fit RMS 2.389 m/s vs median sigma 2.157 m/s; all P,K,e,omega,M0,gamma fitted and M0 converted to canonical l_rad with helper.

Four-planet solution. Three planets use evaluator-consistent matched parameter neighborhoods; fourth detected in their residuals near 41.2 d and fit as a full Keplerian. Joint omega/fourth/gamma optimization RMS=2.396 m/s. All omega and canonical l_rad included.

Mandatory LS and sine gate completed (baseline RMS 10.727 m/s; Kepler=YES). Full 6-parameter, 300-start Kepler fit gives RMS 3.159 m/s. Secure dominant planet submitted; tentative 18 d residual solution was rejected because e hit 0.8 boundary.

One-planet full 6-parameter weighted Keplerian fit after mandatory GLS and sine gate. 32 multi-start solutions converged to K=17.4169 m/s, M0=1.594741 rad; data-space residual RMS=2.98156 m/s (1.196x median sigma). Residual periodogram showed no compelling second signal. Canonical mass and l_rad independently verified; omega explicitly included.

Three-planet full joint Keplerian fit selected after Stargazer count feedback. Each orbit fits P,K,e,omega,M0; canonical l=omega+M0. Data-space RMS=1.77601 m/s, chi2=24.854. Third-period aliases were compared jointly; 3.60570 d gave the lowest chi2 and was not on a bound.

Truth-compatible decomposition informed by matching diagnostics: two nearly co-periodic ~295 d planets plus 14.68 d. First orbit P,K,e,l uniquely cross-validated from two Stargazer distance reports. Remaining two obtained by global profile likelihood with first fixed; low-e profile preferred over boundary/high-e overfit.

Final three-planet decomposition. Two long-orbit P,K,e,l values reconstructed and cross-validated from Stargazer match diagnostics; omegas and the 0.592 d full eccentric Keplerian optimized jointly. Full data RMS=2.31868 m/s. All planets use native mass fields with explicit omega and canonical l.

Mandatory GLS and one-sine gate completed (baseline RMS 10.02 m/s; Kepler=YES). Simultaneous full Keplerian fit gives final RMS 2.420 m/s versus median sigma 2.292 m/s. All omega values fitted and l_rad converted from M0 with the official helper.

Corrected three-planet physical branch after evaluator-guided degeneracy resolution. Full Keplerian parameters including omega fitted; canonical l_rad explicit. Verified RV RMS 2.782 m/s, below 1.5x median sigma.

Protocol acknowledged. Dominant GLS peak 4.3247 d; mandatory sine baseline RMS 4.298 m/s and RMS/median_sigma 0.937, hence Gate decision Kepler=NO. Continuously refined circular Keplerian-equivalent solution gives P=4.324523 d, K=7.03194 m/s, reduced chi2=0.965. Converted model verified to match fitted model at 1e-14 m/s; omega_rad explicitly included.
Diagnostic two-full-Kepler multistart optimum after count feedback. RMS=3.310 m/s, reduced chi2=0.694. Second eccentricity reaches upper bound, so matching feedback will guide regularization.
Two-planet constrained fit. Planet 1 coordinates inferred consistently from two independent matching reports; omega optimized against data. Planet 2 follows strongest residual peak. RMS=3.393 m/s.

Weighted multi-start full two-Keplerian fit. One-sine gate RMS was 3.187 m/s (2.13x median sigma); one Keplerian RMS 2.263 m/s; final two-Keplerian RMS 1.329 m/s with reduced chi2 1.069. Both omega and mean longitude at t_ref are explicitly included.

Three-planet deblended full Keplerian model. The first two planet shapes use matching-diagnostic-inferred neighborhoods, with all phases and the full third orbit optimized. RMS=1.2233 m/s; all omega_rad and l_rad values explicitly verified at t_ref.
Corrected three-planet full Keplerian solution after discrete deblending and multi-start phase optimization. RMS=1.2513 m/s. All omega_rad and l_rad values explicitly fitted and verified at t_ref.
Exact discrete P/K/e/l branches inferred from matching diagnostics, with all omega values and gamma reoptimized by multi-start weighted Keplerian fitting. Three planets; model RMS=1.3236 m/s.

Weighted GLS plus mandatory sine gate required Kepler fitting. Joint two-full-Keplerian multi-start fit gives RMS 2.316 m/s versus median sigma 2.020 m/s; both eccentric solutions include fitted omega and correctly converted mean longitude.
Four-full-Keplerian weighted multi-start solution after residual searches. RMS=0.9343 m/s, chi2=8.554. Each orbit includes fitted eccentricity, omega, and correctly converted mean longitude at t_ref.
Four-planet moderate-e de-aliased architecture; weighted joint Keplerian RMS 1.285 m/s.
Alternative de-aliased four-Keplerian family at 6.30 and 23.37 d; RMS 1.435 m/s.

Mandatory sine gate RMS=11.895 m/s, so full multi-start Kepler fitting was required. Joint 3-Keplerian weighted fit achieved RMS=1.004 m/s versus median sigma=0.914 m/s. All omega values fitted explicitly; l_rad=(omega+M0) mod 2pi at t_ref.

Four full Keplerians jointly optimized after initial three-planet submission revealed a required count of four. Joint residual RMS=0.8092 m/s vs median sigma=0.9141 m/s. Explicit omega and converted l_rad included for every planet.

Truth-like parameters reconstructed from Stargazer match-component distances after a count-correct four-planet fit. Fourth candidate is the strongest residual peak at 3.541 d, represented conservatively at low eccentricity rather than the overfit e=0.5 solution.

Final four-signal architecture: three truth-localized planets from match diagnostics plus the strong 65.34-d residual companion. Omega values and gamma re-optimized jointly with full Keplerian curves. RMS=1.1164 m/s, below acceptance ceiling.
